baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive قُتِلَ, the interrogative كَيْفَ, and the deliberate form قَدَّرَ form one compact judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The initial فـ makes a lethal passive verdict erupt as a consequence, while كَيْفَ turns attention to the manner of a deliberately engineered estimate. The object of condemnation is therefore not an accidental error but the act of contrivance itself.

activation_trace.role: Putting to death supplies the passive, annihilating force of the verdict.
Deliberative measuring and planning identifies the condemned act as a worked-out contrivance.

changed_reading.before: Someone estimated and was then killed.
changed_reading.after: The line pronounces ruin upon the very production of a calculated scheme: ruined be he, how deliberately he fashioned it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُتِلَ and قَدَّرَ can be heard as competing claims to cognitive mastery, with كَيْفَ exposing their mismatch.
baseline_models.mechanism: A distant branch of ق ت ل denotes complete mastery of a fact, whereas ق د ر makes an affair bounded by deliberate measurement. Read ironically through the passive form, the attempted mastery is itself mastered and nullified: the estimator encloses the matter in his calculation only to be enclosed by the verdict.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies the ironic epistemic register beneath the overt lethal passive.
Bringing a thing to a measured limit supplies the boundedness of the estimator's claimed comprehension.
Calculated reflection supplies the mental operation whose claim to mastery is reversed.

changed_reading.before: قُتِلَ contributes only a curse of physical destruction.
changed_reading.after: Alongside the curse, the line stages an epistemic reversal in which a finite estimate pretending to mastery is itself overpowered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats both charged roots and the interrogative frame, but places ثُمَّ before the repeated verdict. The focus is no longer a single outburst: immediate consequence is followed by a resumed, temporally marked rejudgment of the same contrivance.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence supplies the first lethal verdict.
The focus occurrence supplies the deliberately contrived object of judgment.
The repeated putting-to-death image renews rather than merely recalls the verdict.
The repeated planning image keeps the same crafted estimate under renewed scrutiny.

structural_cues: 74:20 exactly reprises قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ while adding ثُمَّ before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact reprise and connector shift; I infer that ثُمَّ restarts the verdict after an interval, while a live alternative is that it provides rhetorical emphasis without a second procedural stage.

changed_reading.before: 74:19 is one instantaneous curse against a bad calculation.
changed_reading.after: The judgment arrives in two tempos, immediate and then resumed, making the act of calculation subject to repeated adjudication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus lies inside a process that begins with inward mental turning and estimation, continues through looking and visible resistance, and ends in an uttered attribution to transmitted material. قَدَّرَ therefore becomes the design stage of a public label; قُتِلَ interrupts and condemns the conversion of inspection into a prefabricated slogan.

activation_trace.role: The lethal verdict cuts into the middle of the surrounding production sequence.
Deliberative planning anchors the focus as the design stage of the eventual claim.
The heart's repeated turning supplies private rehearsal before the estimate is fixed.
The preceding occurrence explicitly joins reflective thought to deliberate estimation.
Directed sight adds an inspection stage after the repeated condemnation.
The branch of asserting or attributing what is not supplies the scheme's conversion into a fabricated public claim.
Transmission of a report supplies the content assigned by that public claim.

structural_cues: The ordered chain 74:18-24 runs from thought and estimate through repeated judgment, looking, facial reaction, turning away, self-elevation, and speech.
The demonstrative claim at 74:24 is the first explicit product after the focus's question about how he estimated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered verbs and final quotation; I infer that they are stages in one act of rhetorical manufacture, while a live alternative is a merely chronological report with no strict causal dependency between stages.

changed_reading.before: كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ marvels generally at the quality of an estimate.
changed_reading.after: It exposes how a private rehearsal was engineered into a dismissive public classification, with the lethal verdict falling on that manufacture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the man's estimate, the speaker measures a created life, extends its provision, and prepares its conditions; the recipient then desires further increase. His later قَدَّرَ can thus be heard as a derivative agent trying to seize the allocator's role, and قُتِلَ as the abrupt humbling of that counterfeit control.

activation_trace.role: Subduing until force is softened supplies the humbling of claimed autonomous control.
Capacity and command supply the power claim latent in taking charge of the outcome.
Deliberate arrangement supplies the man's attempted control of the affair.
Measuring and shaping a created thing establishes an upstream act of determination.
Connected augmentation supplies the extended provision received by the estimator.
Preparation and leveling supply the conditions arranged for him before his own scheme.
The heart's coveting supplies the motive to treat prior provision as entitlement.
Seeking increase gives the entitlement a directional aim beyond what was allotted.

structural_cues: First-person provisioning in 74:11-14 precedes the recipient's appetite for increase in 74:15 and his deliberation in 74:18-19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence of prior allocation, appetite, and later planning; I infer a rivalry between upstream and derivative acts of determination, while a live alternative is that the provisioning only explains motive and does not qualify the semantics of قَدَّرَ.

changed_reading.before: The man devises an isolated verbal judgment.
changed_reading.after: His devising also enacts counterfeit allocation: a provisioned recipient tries to control the measure and future increase, only to be forcefully reduced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exact count is explicitly made an assay whose effects include settled certainty and disturbed doubt. That sequence retroactively places the focus estimator inside a larger experiment: he responds to measured material by manufacturing a reductive category, and the response reveals rather than masters his epistemic condition.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies the ironic standard that the estimator fails to meet.
Measured limit supplies the focus's finite act of quantifying or bounding the matter.
Enumerating the counted supplies a precise later counterpart to the focus's measuring.
Testing metal or person turns the count from inert datum into an exposing assay.
Settled knowledge without doubt supplies one outcome produced by the assay.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting outcome that exposes an unsettled response.

structural_cues: 74:30 states a precise number, and 74:31 immediately explains the count through divergent epistemic effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later counted test and its opposed outcomes; I infer that this measurement mirrors and audits the focus's act of estimation, while a live alternative is that the two measuring events remain thematically separate.

changed_reading.before: The estimator is the knowing subject who assesses an external object badly.
changed_reading.after: His estimate is itself test data: the measured sign elicits a response that reveals him as the object being assessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The universal rule that each self is held as security for what it acquires, followed by denial of the day of account, converts the focus's mental operation into a liable deed. Thinking, estimating, and publicly naming form an acquisition that binds its maker; the lethal passive reads as judgment on an act already entered into account.

activation_trace.role: Putting to death supplies the severe consequence attached to the acquired act.
Deliberate planning makes the focus operation attributable rather than involuntary.
The thing's own self supplies the personal bearer of liability.
Acquiring a gain supplies the model of an act becoming its agent's possession.
Security held against a right supplies the binding relation between agent and acquired act.
Accounting and recompense supply the horizon in which the deliberate estimate remains answerable.

structural_cues: The earlier sequence moves from private thought to spoken classification; 74:38 universalizes liability, and 74:43-46 lists enacted and denied obligations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a universal acquisition-liability rule after the estimator's sequence; I apply that rule retrospectively to his deliberate classification, while a live alternative is that 74:38 concerns only the later confessed omissions.

changed_reading.before: قَدَّرَ is a transient interior thought followed by an external curse.
changed_reading.after: The calculation is an acquired, accountable act that holds its maker, so قُتِلَ voices liability generated through deliberate cognition and speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets repeated ب ش ر shift from the human category to exposed skin and reads a later bodily image back through the focus. It remains valid as a focus-anchored reversal of the calculated label under قَدَّرَ and the lethal verdict under قُتِلَ. Downstream prose should present it as packet-supported wordplay, not as a claim that either occurrence has only the surface sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The calculated act in 74:19 produces the later label 'human speech,' while its lethal verdict provides the pivot by which that label rebounds upon the human surface.

activation_trace.role: Putting to death supplies the judgment that rebounds upon the maker of the label.
Deliberative planning ties the later phrase to a manufactured classification.
The human being supplies the category into which the calculated claim places the discourse.
Visible skin or surface supplies the corporeal site on which the later answer appears.
Heat that changes color supplies the counter-inscription upon that human surface.

changed_reading.before: The man calculates that the discourse is merely human speech and is condemned for the claim.
changed_reading.after: His calculated human label rebounds materially: what he reduces to 'human' is answered by judgment made visible upon the human surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus has passive قُتِلَ, not the idiom 'slayer of winters,' and the feeding image comes much later. It remains anchored through the same ق ت ل root and gains a functional contrast from the explicit failure to feed. Downstream prose should mark it as an ironic branch inversion, not a lexical replacement for the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus condemns a carefully made verbal act; a distant ق ت ل branch names one who defeats lethal winter by sustaining others, creating a social counterimage to that act.

activation_trace.role: The idiomatic slayer of winters supplies a life-preserving counterimage through feeding and warming.
Deliberate planning supplies the contrast between rhetorical ingenuity and absent sustaining action.
Giving food to another supplies the concrete sustaining act explicitly confessed as absent.
Provision that stabilizes a person's stay sharpens the needy recipient's material dependence.

changed_reading.before: The focus opposes a bad intellectual scheme with a lethal curse.
changed_reading.after: A distant social echo contrasts clever verbal killing with the missing work of defeating deathly conditions by feeding and sustaining another.

strongest_changes: The exact 74:20 reprise converts one explosive verdict into repeated adjudication in two temporal registers.
The 74:18-24 sequence reveals قَدَّرَ as the design stage in manufacturing a public dismissive label.
The counted test of 74:30-31 reverses subject and object: the estimator's response becomes evidence by which he is measured.
The acquisition-and-pledge rule at 74:38 makes deliberate calculation an accountable act rather than an evanescent thought.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's violent and measuring roots remained stable anchors while context made the same compact line function as repeated verdict, exposed production process, counterfeit allocation, epistemic assay, and liability relation without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The epistemic mastery branch of ق ت ل and the winter-slayer branch are deliberately form-distant from passive قُتِلَ.
The later counted test may echo the focus's measurement without directly glossing it.
The ب ش ر surface reversal is a controlled polysemic activation and should not displace the ordinary human-category reading.
